subject: physics
title: Hadrons: Baryons and Mesons
welcome_lead: Pack quarks into threes for baryons or pairs for mesons.
meta_desc: A-Level Particle Physics adventure on hadrons, baryons, mesons and conservation rules.
final_note: Quark composition must give the observed charge — and baryon number must be conserved.

concepts.def: Particle made of quarks; feels strong force.

walkthroughs.body_html: Baryons consist of three quarks. Proton = uud (charge +1). Neutron = udd (charge 0). Both have baryon number B = +1.
Mesons consist of one quark and one antiquark. Pions and kaons are the most common. All mesons have B = 0 and are short-lived.
In every reaction: charge, baryon number, lepton number conserve. Strangeness conserved in strong/EM but can change by ±1 in weak interactions.
